title: Confirm sign-in code
purpose: Enter the emailed code in the browser window that requested it to continue signing in to your laboratory account.

items.label: Recipient
items.description: Read-only email address entered on the request page. Its email link opens your mail application; it does not change the recipient. If the address is wrong, cancel and request a code again with the correct address. The confirmation screen appears for unknown addresses too, so it does not establish that an account exists.

items.label: Code
items.description: Required one-time code from the latest sign-in email. Enter it in this browser window within five minutes of the original request. A code requested in another browser cannot complete this sign-in.

items.label: Confirm
items.description: Checks the code for the pending sign-in. An incorrect code shows a field error; three unsuccessful submissions abandon the attempt and return to the request page. A valid code verifies the account email and continues to an enrolled second factor when applicable, then to the allowed requested destination or dashboard.

items.label: Request new code
items.description: Emails a replacement to the same address without requiring the Code field. The replacement invalidates earlier codes. You can request two replacements during one attempt; the action then disappears. Resending does not restart the five-minute deadline or reset unsuccessful submissions.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Ends the pending sign-in and returns to the password sign-in page. No account is created and no laboratory access is granted.

sections.title: Expired or missing sign-in attempt
paragraphs: This page requires a pending code request in the current browser session. If the attempt expires or is missing, you return to the code request page when email-code sign-in is enabled, or to password sign-in when it is disabled. Request a fresh code to start again. A successful code completes only its pending attempt; it cannot start a new session by itself.

Use the account your laboratory issued. Unknown or inactive accounts receive no usable sign-in code even though the confirmation page looks the same. If no sign-in email arrives, check the address and mail folders, then contact your laboratory for account or delivery assistance.
